description: Cell type terms from the Cell Ontology (CL), excluding obsolete terms. Selected terms also carry Human Protein Atlas tissue-context labels and annotations from the Allen HMBA basal ganglia consensus taxonomy.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Source attribution; includes "Cell Ontology". The HMBA annotations do not add an entry to this node property.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time of the most recent creation or property change.

source_contributions.scope: Active CL terms; obsolete terms and terms belonging to other ontologies are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Provides cell type names, definitions, synonyms and cross-references.

properties.name: definition
properties.description: Text definition of the cell type, when available.

properties.name: synonyms
properties.description: Synonym strings from the Cell Ontology, when available.

properties.name: xrefs
properties.description: Cross-references, when available; values retain their source representation as CURIEs or full URIs.

source_contributions.scope: Cell types with a curated Human Protein Atlas tissue-context mapping. Mapping coverage is incomplete and uneven.
source_contributions.description: Adds a human-readable label combining the HPA tissue and cell type names. This contribution describes tissue context without expression-level information.

properties.name: hybrid_node_name
properties.description: HPA tissue and cell type label in the form "[Tissue] [Cell type]". When multiple labels refer to the same CL term, only one label is retained, so this is not an exhaustive list of tissue contexts.

source_contributions.scope: Existing Cell Ontology terms representing Group-level cell types in the HMBA basal ganglia consensus primate taxonomy CCN20250428. Higher taxonomy levels and species-specific Clusters are excluded. Provisional Groups are represented separately as ProvCellType nodes.
source_contributions.description: Adds Group symbols, curated marker-set labels and a study label from the Basal Ganglia Ontology.

properties.name: hmba_symbol
properties.description: Group symbol from the Basal Ganglia Ontology, when available, for example "GPe MEIS2-SOX6 GABA (Primate)".

properties.name: hmba_marker_set_labels
properties.description: Symbols listed in the Group’s curated marker-set label, when a marker set is available. The authors’ casing is preserved.

properties.name: hmba_study_description
properties.description: Study label: "Allen HMBA Basal Ganglia Release".
